*CPB Branch Banking employees **Aaron Fernandez** (from left), **Michelle Salvador** , and **Bob Yee** participated in the blessing ceremony with **Kahu Kordell Kekoa** , at the new full service Kapiolani Branch, featuring state-of-the-art ATMs, safe deposit boxes, and validated parking. HONOLULU, HI (Oct. 20, 2026) –


Central Pacific Bank (CPB) is pleased to announce that its Kapiolani Branch has temporarily relocated from 1538 Kapiolani Blvd., Suite 103, to the Pan Am Building, located just one block away at 1600 Kapiolani Blvd., Suite 110. The new branch celebrated its soft opening with a traditional blessing ceremony on Tuesday, Oct. 13, 2026.


"We are committed to serving this vibrant community and we want to sincerely thank our loyal customers for finding us in our beautiful new location," said **Kisan Jo** , EVP, Retail, Wealth, and International Markets with Central Pacific Bank. "We look forward to continuing to provide the personalized financial guidance and solutions our customers expect and deserve."


The temporary relocation was prompted to make way for a new development project called **Muse Honolulu** , led by JL Capital. The upcoming development will provide housing options for people, conveniently located right across the street from the Ala Moana Shopping Center. CPB plans to open its permanent Kapiolani Branch in the new Muse Honolulu building when construction is complete.


**About the New CPB Kapiolani Branch**


The new Kapiolani Branch is a full-service financial center designed to meet all customer banking needs. Features and amenities include:


·


**Advanced ATM Capabilities:** Both indoor and outdoor state-of-the-art ATMs equipped with multi-language options and multi-denomination dispensing capabilities.


·


**Full-Service Banking:** Account openings, foreign exchange services, wire transfers, night depository services, and safe deposit boxes.


·


**Convenient Access:** Validated parking is available at the Pan Am Building during normal bank operating hours.


For more information, branch hours, or to schedule an appointment, please visit:


[https://www.cpb.bank/locations/kapiolani-branch/](https://www.cpb.bank/locations/kapiolani-branch/)


For more information about the Muse Honolulu project visit:


[https://musehonolulu.com](https://musehonolulu.com/)

**About Central Pacific Financial Corp.**


Central Pacific Financial Corp. **** is a Hawaii-based bank holding company with approximately $7.50 billion in assets as of June 30, 2026. Central Pacific Bank, its primary subsidiary, operates 27 branches and 56 ATMs in the State of Hawaii. Central Pacific Financial Corp. is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) under the symbol “CPF.” For additional information, please visit:
